extracted.name: Lumps of Coal
extracted.description: These "lumps of coal" are desserts made of crushed Oreos®, butter, and marshmallows for a fun holiday treat for those that Santa may skip over.
ingredient_lines: 1 (20 ounce) package chocolate sandwich cookies (such as Oreo®), crushed
instruction_lines: Melt butter in a large saucepan over low heat; add marshmallows and stir until melted. Cook and stir mixture for 2 minutes more. Remove saucepan from heat. Stir crushed cookies into marshmallow mixture until well coated.
Press cookie mixture firmly into the prepared baking dish using a buttered spatula or waxed paper; cool. Cut into 2-inch squares.
